Fitted separations of transition wavenumbers (cm-1).
Blends: separation of each component from the strongest one; tau = prior uncertainty of the
separation (Blend separation factor * FWHM); u = its uncertainty after the fit.
u/tau near 1: the separation is determined by the resolution only (not by the lines).
|sep/tau| > 2: the components are farther apart than the resolution suggests.
User: separations from the separations-input file; z = (fitted - given)/given uncertainty.
r = redundancy number of the separation observation (blends: each component at the common
position of the blend; user: the given separation); rel_dev = (given - fitted)/(its sigma).
Line = the observed wavelength of the blend, or "user (line N)": the line No. N of the
separations-input file. W_inp1, W_inp2 = the observed wavelengths of the two transitions
as given in the transitions file (empty if a transition is not there); Unit = their unit.
